title: 연음 1: 받침 + ㅇ → 넘어가요 (음악 [으막])
objective: Read words like 음악 [으막] and 직업이 [지거비] aloud, moving the 받침 over.
summary: A final consonant (받침) moves into the next syllable when it starts with a silent ㅇ.

task.title: Read and write the sounds
task.line: Say each word aloud first, then choose or write how it really sounds in [ ].

words.exampleMeaning: What do you do for a living?

letters.sound: The 받침 moves into the next empty ㅇ: 음악 [으막], 한국어 [한구거].
This also happens before 이, 을, 에: 직업이 [지거비], 집에 [지베].
A 받침 ㅇ does not move: 영어 [영어], 가방에 [가방에].
letters.as: Like the 'ng' in 'singer'; it stays in place.

exercises: Choose the correct sound: ① 밥을 → [바블] or [밥을]? ② 길이 → [길이] or [기리]? ③ 먹어요 → [머거요] or [먹어요]?
Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 발음 → [ ] ② 일요일 → [ ] ③ 금요일 → [ ]
Does the 받침 move to the next syllable? Write Yes or No: ① 손을 ② 가방에 ③ 목요일
Write how the sentence sounds: ① 옷을 사요. ② 이름이 뭐예요?
answers: ① Yes [소늘] ② No [가방에] ③ Yes [모교일]
